songs.title: In All You Have Made
songs.lyrics:
Intro

Holy God, with Your own Will reigning in me,
With Your intensity of Love,
With Your own immensity of Love,
I love You, thank You and adore You
In all that You have made.

Verse 1 — Heavens

In all the stars and all the planets,
In every meteor passing by,
In sun and moon, in earth and heavens,
In every world across the sky,
In Mars and Jupiter and Pluto,
In all the wonders You have made,
I sing Your praise, I sing Your glory,
I love You, Lord, in all You've made.

Chorus

I sing Your praise, I sing Your glory,
I love You in all You have made.
May Your Kingdom come and reign, Lord,
May Your Holy Will be done.
May Your Kingdom come and reign, Lord,
On earth as it reigns in Heaven.

Verse 2 — Sky and Weather

In all the skies and in the breezes,
In every wind that moves the air,
In falling rain and softly falling snow,
In every rainbow shining there,
In every storm and roll of thunder,
In every flash of lightning bright,
I sing Your praise, I sing Your glory,
I love You in Your wind and light.

Chorus

I sing Your praise, I sing Your glory,
I love You in all You have made.
May Your Kingdom come and reign, Lord,
May Your Holy Will be done.
May Your Kingdom come and reign, Lord,
On earth as it reigns in Heaven.

Verse 3 — Birds

In all the birds, in all their singing,
In every wing that soars in flight,
In building nests and feeding their young,
In lofty flights from height to height,
In every branch where they find resting,
In every song at break of day,
I sing Your praise, I sing Your glory,
I love You, Lord, in all You've made.

Verse 4 — Animals

In all the animals You've given,
In dogs and cats and cattle too,
In goats and gazelles, deer and rabbits,
In every life created by You,
In lions, tigers and the bears, Lord,
In creatures great and creatures small,
I sing Your praise, I sing Your glory,
I love You, Lord, within them all.

Chorus

I sing Your praise, I sing Your glory,
I love You in all You have made.
May Your Kingdom come and reign, Lord,
May Your Holy Will be done.
May Your Kingdom come and reign, Lord,
On earth as it reigns in Heaven.

Verse 5 — Insects

In every insect, every creature,
In caterpillars, beetles too,
In butterflies upon the flowers,
In spiders weaving webs anew,
In every bee among the blossoms,
In every tiny living thing,
I sing Your praise, I sing Your glory,
To You my love and thanks I bring.

Verse 6 — Earth and Stones

In all the rocks and all the mountains,
In every pebble, every stone,
In mighty cliffs and ancient boulders,
In treasures hidden and unknown,
In gold and silver, gems and jewels,
In ruby, sapphire, precious jade,
I sing Your praise, I sing Your glory,
I love You, Lord, in all You've made.

Bridge

In everything that lives and moves,
In everything that breathes,
I place my love, my praise, my thanks
In all that You have made.

Final Chorus

I sing Your praise, I sing Your glory,
I love You in all You have made.
May Your Kingdom come and reign, Lord,
May Your Holy Will be done.
May Your Kingdom come and reign, Lord,
On earth as it reigns in Heaven.

Outro

In all creation, through all ages,
I praise You, thank You and adore You.
With Your own Will reigning in me,
I love You in all You have made.
May Your Kingdom come and reign
On earth as it reigns in Heaven.

songs.title: Creation with You
songs.lyrics:
Holy Father, I pour myself
Into Your Holy Will.
And as You bring creation forth,
I long to be there with You.
In every star You set in place,
In every sphere You form,
In everything Your hands create,
I want to create with You.

Each star that shines within the heavens,
I place it there with You.
The sun that burns, the moon that glows,
I make them shine with You.
The planets turning in their paths,
I set them all with You.
The lights that govern day and night,
I form each one with You.

Every comet, every galaxy,
I bring them forth with You.
The Milky Way, the Whirlpool too,
I fashion them with You.
The meteor showers streaking by,
I send them forth with You.
The elements that form the stars,
I gather them with You.

The motion of the heavenly spheres,
I turn them all with You.
The colors glowing in the nebulae,
I paint them there with You.
Mercury, Venus, Earth and Mars,
Jupiter shining too,
And distant Pluto in the dark—
I form each one with You.

The trees and wind, the land and sea,
I bring them forth with You.
The birds and beasts, the breath of air,
I make them all with You.
Never may You be alone;
I offer You my company.
Ever at Your side in wonder,
I delight in all I see.

I love You with Your own great power.
I love You with Your strength.
I love You with all the love
The Trinity contains.
I seal each star,
I seal each moon,
I seal all things with love.
And gathering all creation now,
I offer it to You.

Receive this gift, O Father,
From the whole human family.
I bring creation back to You
With love and thanksgiving.
And in return, I ask You, Lord:
Restore Your Divine order.
Let Your Kingdom reign on earth
As once You willed it to reign.

May Your Kingdom come,
May Your Will be done,
On earth as it is in Heaven.
May Your Kingdom come,
May Your Will be done,
On earth as it is in Heaven.

Come, Holy Spirit,
Come reign on earth.
Come, Holy Spirit,
Come reign on earth.
Come, Holy Spirit,
Come reign on earth.

songs.title: The Innocent Acts of Adam
songs.lyrics:
Intro
My God, on behalf of Adam,
With Your Will, I come before Your throne,
To love, praise and adore You once again
In all Adam did before his fall.

Chorus
I thank You, Lord, in all the rivers of love
And perennial joy You flowed upon him,
Adam, Your son, the firstborn of Your Divine Will.
I give them back to You once again.

Verse 1
As he spoke, as he walked,
In his thoughts, in his steps,
In his laughter, in his eating,
Tending the garden You made for his home.

Bridge
In Your Will, with Adam, I say together with him,
“I love You, my God, my Father,
the Author of this, my life.”
And may Your Kingdom come
In the innocent acts of Adam.

Verse 2
As he breathed, as he ate,
In his smiles, in his wonder,
In his sleeping, in his waking,
Naming the creatures You brought before him.
In Your Will, with his own mouth, I say once again,
“I love You, my God, my Father,
the Author of this, my life.”

Verse 3
As he ran, as he climbed,
In his resting, in his playing,
In his seeing, in his hearing,
Tending the garden You made for his home.
In Your Will, with his own mouth, I say once again,
“I love You, my God, my Father,
the Author of this, my life.”

Outro
I gather all the innocent acts of Adam,
And in Your Will, I give them back to You.
With his love, I love You once again,
May Your Kingdom come and reign on earth.

songs.title: Offering the Rounds of the Patriarchs and Prophets
songs.lyrics:
O Lord, I enter Your Divine Will,
And gather the acts of Your servants of old.
In every prayer, every sacrifice,
In every word spoken for You,
I love You, I praise You,
I bless You and thank You.
With Noah, as he trusted Your warning,
And built the ark at Your command,
I love You in his steadfast perseverance,
In every faithful work of his hands.
With Abraham, when You called him forth,
And he left his homeland at Your word,
I love You in his complete surrender,
And in the covenant You made with him.
With Joseph, betrayed by his brothers,
Yet steadfast through suffering and trial,
I love You in his resilience and forgiveness,
As You used him to save many lives from famine.
Lord, in every holy act they offered,
In every prayer, sacrifice, and praise,
I love You, bless You, praise You, thank You,
And gather them all within Your Divine Will.
With Moses before the burning bush,
As he led Your people out of bondage,
I love You in his leadership and intercession,
And every step through the wilderness.
With David, shepherd, king, and psalmist,
I love You in every song he sang,
In his repentance and his longing for You,
In every praise that rose from his heart.
With Micah, proclaiming justice and mercy,
And calling Your people to walk humbly with You,
I love You in every truth he proclaimed,
And in his hope for the promised Messiah.
Lord, in every holy act they offered,
In every prayer, sacrifice, and praise,
I love You, bless You, praise You, thank You,
And gather them all within Your Divine Will.
In Samuel listening for Your voice,
In Elijah’s burning zeal for Your honor,
In Isaiah proclaiming Your promises,
In Jeremiah’s tears for Your people,
In Daniel’s courage before earthly kings,
And every prophet known to You—
I love You in their every holy word,
I love You in their every sacrifice,
I love You in their sufferings for You,
I love You in their love for Your people.
And in every holy act
Of the patriarchs and prophets,
Known and unknown,
Recorded and hidden,
I gather their love and faithfulness,
And offer them all back to You.
Lord, in every holy act they offered,
In every prayer, sacrifice, and praise,
I love You, bless You, praise You, thank You,
And gather them all within Your Divine Will.
Holy God, with Your own Divine Love,
I love You in them all.
I praise You in them all.
I bless You in them all.
I thank You in them all,
Now and forever,
In Your Divine Will.

songs.title: A Mother with Mary to You
songs.lyrics:
Jesus, I pour myself into Your Divine Will,
And here, together with Mary,
I intend to be a mother to You.
As she kissed You, as she sang You lullabies,
As she washed You, dried the tears You cried,
In all she offered, all she said to You,
I intend, with her, in God’s Will, to do.
As she held You, as she prayed for You,
As she rocked You and cared for You,
As she washed and folded Your little clothes,
I intend to do with her what she did for You.
As she watched You grow from day to day,
As she walked with You and watched You play,
As she treasured every memory in her heart,
I intend with Mary to take part.
As she walked beside You through the years,
Shared Your laughter, comforted Your tears,
In every little act of motherhood,
I join my love with hers in all she did.
Together with Mother Mary,
I intend to mother You,
My little Baby Jesus,
So gentle, sweet, and true.
Tender little Jesus,
Yet courageous, brave, and strong,
With Mary I will love You,
And stay with You all along.

songs.title: The Acts of the Holy Family
songs.lyrics:
Holy God, I pour myself into Your Divine Will,
And here, within Your immensity of love,
I enter every act of the Holy Family.
In every little thing they did,
Lord, I love You, bless You, and thank You,
And I gather all their acts to offer them back to You.

As Mary prepared the meals,
As she washed and mended clothes,
As she swept their little home,
And tended the fire that warmed them,
As she served Jesus and Joseph,
And brought them food and water,
In every loving work of her hands,
Lord, I love You in them all.

In every act of the Holy Family,
Lord, I love You, bless You, and thank You.
I gather every act and offer it to You
On behalf of all humanity.

As Joseph worked the wood,
Providing for Jesus and Mary,
As he taught young Jesus his trade,
Working side by side with Him,
As he guarded Mary and Jesus,
And led them safely into Egypt,
In every sacrifice and hidden care,
Lord, I love You in them all.

In every act of the Holy Family,
Lord, I love You, bless You, and thank You.
I gather every act and offer it to You
On behalf of all humanity.

As Jesus helped His Mother,
In the little tasks of home,
As He worked beside Saint Joseph,
And obeyed him with love,
In His words and in His footsteps,
In His smiles and hidden acts,
In every ordinary moment,
Lord, I love You in them all.

In every act of the Holy Family,
Lord, I love You, bless You, and thank You.
I gather every act and offer it to You
On behalf of all humanity.

As Jesus, Mary, and Joseph
Ate and spoke together,
As they listened to each other,
And walked and traveled side by side,
In their journeys to Jerusalem,
In their prayers and holy feasts,
In all their silence and conversation,
Lord, I love You in them all.

In Mary serving Joseph,
In Joseph serving Mary,
In their tender care for Jesus,
And Jesus loving them,
In every prayer and sacrifice,
In every joy and suffering,
I gather all their holy acts
And offer them to You.

In every act of the Holy Family,
Lord, I love You, bless You, and thank You.
I gather every act and offer it to You
On behalf of all humanity.
May the fruits of all their acts
Descend upon the earth,
May they overflow through every soul,
And rise in praise to Heaven.
May every home become a Nazareth,
Where love and peace increase,
And may Your Divine Will reign in every family,
As in Heaven, so on earth.

songs.title: All the Ordinary Things
songs.lyrics:
Lord, I immerse myself in Your Divine Will,
and gather every ordinary human act in You.
In every human breath, I love You.
In every heartbeat, bless You.
In every human step, I honor You.
In every movement, praise You.
In waking and in sleeping,
in resting through the night,
I gather all these human acts
and join them to Your life.
In laughter and in smiling,
in every joyful sound,
in every tear that mankind sheds,
let love for You be found.
In sorrow and in suffering,
in comfort and in pain,
I love, adore, and thank You,
and offer all again.
In all the ordinary things,
be glorified, O Lord.
In every little human act,
be loved and praised by all.
I gather them in Your Divine Will,
united with Your own,
with all Your hidden acts on earth,
for God's great glory alone.
In washing and in cleaning,
in dressing for the day,
in brushing teeth and combing hair,
I place my love and praise.
In sewing and in cooking,
in making daily bread,
in every little task we do,
be loved and honored there.
In going forth to labor,
providing for our homes,
in driving down the highway,
wherever mankind goes,
In running and in jumping,
in climbing, sports, and play,
I love, bless, praise, and thank You
in the movements of each day.
In all the ordinary things,
be glorified, O Lord.
In every little human act,
be loved and praised by all.
I gather them in Your Divine Will,
united with Your own,
with all Your hidden acts on earth,
for God's great glory alone.
In tending to the garden,
in caring for the home,
in swimming through the water,
in every path we roam,
In every innocent pleasure,
in friendship and in play,
I gather all that's good and pure
and offer it today.
In every sight of beauty,
in every sound we hear,
in every scent and fragrance,
in every taste that's pure,
In every gentle touch of love,
I gather every sense,
uniting them with Jesus' acts,
so holy and innocent.
Jesus, I unite them all
with the hidden acts of Your life:
every breath and every heartbeat,
every step and sacrifice;
Your working and Your resting,
Your laughter and Your tears,
Your seeing and Your hearing,
through all Your hidden years.
I unite the acts of mankind
with every act You lived,
and offer all within Your Will
for God's great glory.

songs.title: In the Mystery of Your Transfiguration
songs.lyrics:
Lord, I fuse myself in Your Divine Will,
and here I pray.
Holy Jesus, in Your Divine Will,
I love You calling them apart:
Peter, James, and John with You,
You lead them upward from the start.
I bless You in each step You take,
ascending for their sake.
I praise You there upon the height,
withdrawn with them to pray.
And as You pray, Your form is changed,
Your glory shines like day.
Before their eyes, a wondrous light
breaks forth upon the height.
I adore You, transfigured,
Your Face shining like the sun.
Your garments gleam in radiant white,
the vision has begun.
I glorify Your hidden light,
now shining in their sight.
[Chorus]
In all Your Divine acts
in the mystery of Your Transfiguration,
I bless You, love You, praise You,
adore and glorify You.
May Your Kingdom come,
may Your Will be done
on earth as it is in Heaven.
I praise You as Moses and Elijah
appear with You in glory.
They speak with You of Your departure,
and all that lies before Thee,
of what You will accomplish
in Jerusalem.
I bless You in Peter’s wonder:
“Lord, it is good for us to be here.”
Overcome by all he sees,
he longs to keep You near:
one tabernacle for You,
for Moses and Elijah too.
I glorify You as the bright cloud
comes and overshadows them.
I praise You as the Father speaks:
“This is My beloved Son,
in whom I am well pleased:
hear ye Him.”
[Chorus]
In all Your Divine acts
in the mystery of Your Transfiguration,
I bless You, love You, praise You,
adore and glorify You.
May Your Kingdom come,
may Your Will be done
on earth as it is in Heaven.
I love You as Your apostles,
hearing the voice, fall down in fear.
I bless You as You come to them,
drawing ever near.
You touch them gently where they lie:
“Arise, and fear not.”
I adore You as they lift their eyes
and suddenly see only You.
The cloud has passed, the vision fades,
Moses and Elijah too.
The glory they had seen is gone,
yet You remain with them alone.
I praise You coming down the mountain,
I bless You every step of the way.
You tell them not to speak
of what they have seen that day,
until the Son of Man
has risen from the dead.
[Final Chorus]
In all Your Divine acts
in the mystery of Your Transfiguration,
I bless You, love You, praise You,
adore and glorify You.
May Your Kingdom come,
may Your Will be done
on earth as it is in Heaven.

songs.title: Mine is the Crime of Love
songs.lyrics:
Jesus, I fuse myself in Your Divine Will.
With Your own Love, I come to love You.
Before Annas, bound and struck,
I place my love upon Your Face.
In every insult, every blow,
I bless You for every soul.
Before Caiaphas, falsely accused,
I praise You in Your innocence.
In every wound, in every pain,
I honor You in Your Divine Will.
“My child, I have committed no crime.
Mine is the crime of Love,
which contains all sacrifices—
Love of immeasurable value…”
Jesus, in Your Divine Will,
I love, bless, and honor You.
For every soul, in every age,
I proclaim Your innocence.
In Your silence and Your gaze,
I place my love and praise in You.
Where they mock, I give You honor;
where they hate, I bless and love You.
Before Herod, mocked and scorned,
I adore the Eternal Word.
In Your silence, in Your shame,
I glorify Your holy Name.
Before Pilate, innocent,
I place my love within Your bonds.
Where the truth is cast aside,
I praise and honor You for all.
Beside Barabbas, rejected King,
I choose and love You for every soul.
Where mankind cries against its God,
I bless, adore, and glorify You.
In every blow—I love You.
In every wound—I bless You.
In every insult—I praise You.
In every sorrow—I honor You.
In every act of Your Passion,
I place my love within Your Will—
for every soul, in every age,
to give You all the glory due.
“My child, I have committed no crime.
Mine is the crime of Love,
which contains all sacrifices—
Love of immeasurable value…”
Jesus, in Your Divine Will,
I love, bless, and honor You.
For every soul, in every age,
I proclaim Your innocence.
Your only crime is Love.
Your only crime is Love.

songs.title: Restore Your Church
songs.lyrics:
Lord, in Your Divine Will I pray….
Heal the limbs that cannot move,
Give new strength and make them whole.
Restore the body’s mobility,
Let Your healing touch restore the soul.
Free the hands and free the feet,
Let the weakened rise and walk;
Let Your healing touch restore them,
Let their bodies sing Your love.
Jesus, restore Your Church,
Make her beautiful and new.
Heal what’s broken, strengthen weak hearts,
Let Your Spirit lead us through.
Jesus, restore our bodies,
Let the bound and broken move.
By Your mercy, by Your Passion,
Make all things new in You.
Repair Your Church, Lord Jesus,
As You called Saint Francis there.
Renew her faith and make her holy,
Fill her with Your love and care.
Heal divisions, heal her wounds,
Set her heart once more aflame;
Let her walk in Your own footsteps,
And proclaim Your holy Name.
St. Francis, pray for us,
That Christ’s Church may rise anew.
St. Camillus, pray for us,
For the sick who turn to You.
Mary, Mother of the Church,
Hold these prayers within Your heart.
Lead us all to Jesus’ Will,
Where healing and renewal start.
Jesus, take my every suffering,
Every cross I have to bear.
For the healing of Your people,
I surrender it in prayer.
For the Church and for the wounded,
For each soul who longs to rise,
Let my little offering join
With Your sacrifice divine.
Jesus, restore Your Church,
Make her beautiful and new.
Heal what’s broken, strengthen weak hearts,
Let Your Spirit lead us through.
Jesus, restore our bodies,
Let the bound and broken move.
By Your mercy, by Your Passion,
Make all things new in You.

songs.title: Holy Angels Pray with me
songs.lyrics:
Jesus, I enter Your Holy Will,
and join the choirs around Your throne.
I gather all their praise and worship,
and offer them for every soul.
Seraphim, burning bright with love,
I ask your prayers for every soul.
Kindle God's love in every heart.
With Heaven I cry: Holy, Holy, Holy!
Cherubim, radiant with wisdom,
I ask your prayers for every soul.
Lead them from sin to holiness;
bring them God's wisdom, light, and truth.
Holy Angels, pray with me,
as I pray for every soul.
May His Kingdom come on earth;
may His Holy Will be done.
Holy Thrones before His presence,
I ask your prayers for every soul.
Obtain for them true humility,
and peaceful trust in God's own Will.
Holy Dominions, I ask your prayers;
guard every heart and every mind.
Help souls govern every passion,
and freely choose what pleases God.
Holy Powers, I ask your prayers;
guard every soul against the foe.
Free them from the snares of evil;
keep them faithful, firm, and true.
Holy Angels, pray with me,
as I pray for every soul.
May His Kingdom come on earth;
may His Holy Will be done.
Holy Virtues, I ask your prayers
for every weary, struggling soul.
Strengthen them against temptation;
may God's grace sustain them all.
Principalities, I ask your prayers;
teach all souls true obedience.
Turn every heart toward God's Will.
May His Kingdom come and reign.
Holy Archangels, I ask your prayers
for every soul throughout the world.
Keep them steadfast in the faith,
and faithful in each work of love.
Holy Angels, pray with me,
as I pray for every soul.
May His Kingdom come on earth;
may His Holy Will be done.
Holy Angels, faithful guardians,
I ask your prayers for every soul.
Guard them through this earthly journey,
and lead them safely home to God.
Seraphim — kindle love.
Cherubim — bring light and truth.
Thrones — obtain humility.
Dominions — help souls choose the good.
Powers — guard all souls from evil.
Virtues — strengthen souls in trial.
Principalities — obtain obedience.
Archangels — strengthen faith.
Angels — guard all souls along the way.
Holy Angels, pray with me,
as I pray for every soul.
May His Kingdom come on earth;
may His Holy Will be done.
All you holy choirs of Heaven,
I join you in your song of praise.
I love Him, bless Him and adore Him,
and intercede for every soul.
May His Kingdom come on earth.
May His Holy Will be done.
With all of Heaven I cry:
Holy, Holy, Holy!
Holy, Holy, Holy!
Holy is the Lord our God.

songs.title: Let All Creation Join the Dance
songs.lyrics:
Jesus, I fuse myself and all humanity
in Your Most Holy Divine Will.
With Your own Love, I come to love You
in every song and dance of praise.
I love You in the songs of Israel,
In Miriam’s timbrel by the sea,
In every voice that sang Your triumph,
In every dance of victory.
I bless You in King David’s dancing,
Before the Ark with all his might.
I join his joy and holy praises,
And offer You his heart’s delight.
“Let them praise his name in the dance:
let them sing praises unto him
with the timbrel and harp.”
Chorus
I AM the Lord of the Dance,
Come, rejoice and sing with Me!
Let all creation join the dance,
And praise the Holy Trinity!
I love You at the wedding feast,
With Mary there beside Your side.
I bless You in the songs of gladness,
The joyful gathering, groom and bride.
I praise You in the celebration,
In every song of love they raise.
I thank You for the water changed to wine,
Your first great sign of grace.
“Thou hast turned for me
my mourning into dancing.”
I love You, Jesus, ascending
In triumph to the Father’s throne,
With souls redeemed through Your great Passion,
Rejoicing in the Love You’ve shown.
Alleluia! I adore You!
With Mary, angels, saints above,
With Adam, Joseph, John, Elijah,
I join their songs of endless love.
With David and the holy prophets,
With every soul Your mercy saves,
I dance around You, King of Glory,
And bless You in their joyful praise!
Chorus
I AM the Lord of the Dance,
Come, rejoice and sing with Me!
Let all creation join the dance,
And praise the Holy Trinity!
I love You in the dance of Heaven,
A dance of joy and delight.
I bless You in the song You’re singing,
A song that’s forever new.
With Mary, saints, and all the angels,
I offer You their love and praise.
I bring all souls before Your Father,
To bless and glorify Your ways.
“Praise him with the timbrel and dance:
praise him with stringed instruments and organs.”
May Heaven’s song resound through ages,
May every heart Your Love proclaim.
May every dance and song of worship
Bring glory to Your Holy Name!
Alleluia! Alleluia!
Let Heaven and earth rejoice.
May Your Kingdom come,
May Your Will be done on earth as it is in Heaven.

songs.title: Let my Love Meet You Dancing with the Stars
songs.lyrics:
I Jesus, I fuse myself in Your Divine Will.
With Your Love, I come to love You.
I love You in the stars above,
That fill the heavens with their light.
I praise You in their sparkling beauty,
Scattered through the velvet night.
I bless You in the silver moon,
That casts its glow upon the sea.
I adore You in the gentle waves,
That shimmer in the evening breeze.
I love You in the Milky Way,
Its countless stars across the sky.
I praise You in the distant galaxies,
Whose splendor fills my wondering eyes.
I bless You in brilliant Sirius,
A jewel in the winter sky.
I honor You in Polaris,
The northern star that guides the eye.
Jesus, let my love meet You,
Dancing with the stars.
I love You, bless You, praise You, Lord,
In the beauty and movement of every star.
I love You in the evening stillness,
As daylight slowly fades away.
I praise You in the first star appearing,
To welcome night at close of day.
I bless You in the heavens unfolding,
Their countless wonders coming into view.
I offer every spark of starlight,
As a little gift of love to You.
I love You in the constellations,
That adorn the heavens high.
I praise You in Betelgeuse,
A reddish star in Orion’s sky.
I bless You in the shooting stars,
That sweep across the darkened skies.
I offer You a thousand loves,
As their golden trails arise.
Jesus, let my love meet You,
Dancing with the stars.
I love You, bless You, praise You, Lord,
In the beauty and movement of every star.
May Your Kingdom come,
May Your Will be done.

songs.title: Singing Psalm 91 with King David
songs.lyrics:
Jesus, I fuse myself in Your Most Holy Divine Will. Together with King David, I intend to sing this Psalm of praise, trust, and Divine protection.
He that dwelleth in the aid of the most High, Shall abide under the protection of the God of Jacob.
He shall say to the Lord: Thou art my protector, and my refuge: My God, in him will I trust.
For he hath delivered me from the snare of the hunters: And from the sharp word.
He will overshadow thee with his shoulders, And under his wings thou shalt trust.
His truth shall compass thee with a shield: Thou shalt not be afraid of the terror of the night.
Of the arrow that flieth in the day, Of the business that walketh about in the dark: Of invasion, or of the noonday devil.
A thousand shall fall at thy side, And ten thousand at thy right hand: But it shall not come nigh thee.
For he hath given his angels charge over thee, To keep thee in all thy ways.
Because he hoped in me, I will deliver him.
Because thou, O Lord, art my hope: Thou hast made the most High thy refuge.
There shall no evil come to thee: Nor shall the scourge come near thy dwelling.
In their hands they shall bear thee up: Lest thou dash thy foot against a stone.
Thou shalt walk upon the asp and the basilisk: And thou shalt trample under foot the lion and the dragon.
Because he hoped in me I will deliver him: I will protect him because he hath known my name.
He shall cry to me, and I will hear him: I am with him in tribulation, I will deliver him, and I will glorify him.
I will fill him with length of days; And I will shew him my salvation.
For he hath given his angels charge over thee, To keep thee in all thy ways.
Because he hoped in me, I will deliver him.

songs.title: Joseph of Egypt
songs.lyrics:
Jesus, I fuse myself in Your Most Holy Divine Will.
I come to love You in Joseph of Egypt,
And in the sufferings of all slaves throughout time.
I love You when Joseph’s brothers betrayed him,
And sold him into slavery far from home.
I praise You in his sorrow and affliction,
For You were with him; he was not alone.
I love You in Joseph’s integrity,
His diligence and faithful work each day.
I bless You when he fled from sinful temptation,
And bore false accusations without blame.
Chorus
Lord, I love You, praise You, honor You,
In the sufferings of all slaves throughout time.
I unite their sufferings with those of Jesus,
And offer them to the Father.
Set humanity free, O Lord,
From the tyranny of the human will.
I love You in Joseph’s perseverance,
His kindness to the prisoners by his side.
I praise You when he gave You glory for their dreams,
Though he himself was forgotten and confined.
I love You when Joseph stood before Pharaoh,
And through Your wisdom made his dreams known.
I praise You when You raised him from the prison,
And placed him at the right hand of the throne.
Chorus
Lord, I love You, praise You, honor You,
In the sufferings of all slaves throughout time.
I unite their sufferings with those of Jesus,
And offer them to the Father.
Set humanity free, O Lord,
From the tyranny of the human will.
I love You in Joseph’s wise preparations,
That saved so many lives from famine’s hand.
I bless You in his mercy toward his brothers,
And praise You for the good brought from their plans.
Final Chorus
Lord, I love You, praise You, honor You,
In the sufferings of all slaves throughout time.
I unite their sufferings with those of Jesus,
And offer them to the Father.
Set humanity free, O Lord,
From the tyranny of the human will.
You thought evil against me,
But God turned it into good,
That He might exalt me,
And preserve countless lives.

songs.title: Tear Off the Roof! A Miracle of Faith
songs.lyrics:
Intro
Jesus, I fuse myself in Your Most Holy Divine Will,
And come to love You in the faith of four men.
Verse 1
Four men carry their suffering friend,
Through crowded streets beneath the sun.
Their arms grow weary, but they press on,
For they believe that You can heal him.
I love You in their faithful footsteps,
I bless You in the weight they bear.
I praise You in their loving friendship,
And thank You for their tender care.
Verse 2
They reach the house where You are teaching,
But crowds are gathered at the door.
They cannot find a way to enter;
There’s hardly room for even one more!
They look above and see the rooftop,
And suddenly they have a plan!
I praise You for their holy wisdom,
And bless the courage of these men!
Verse 3
They climb above the crowded house,
And tear an opening overhead.
The dust falls through the ceiling,
As they lower down their friend’s bed.
The people gasp and turn their heads;
A man descends before their eyes!
I love You in their daring faith,
And praise You in the crowd’s surprise!
Chorus
Tear off the roof! Tear off the roof!
Rejoice in what our God can do!
When faithful hearts make room for grace,
The power of Jesus fills this place!
Tear off the roof! Tear off the roof!
Let every heart proclaim the truth!
He sees our faith, He hears our cry,
And raises up the soul to life!
Verse 4
Their friend lies waiting at Your feet;
Four faithful hearts look down from high.
They’ve brought him all the way to You,
And now they wait for Your reply.
The crowd looks up and sees the roof,
But Jesus looks and sees their faith!
I love You in Your tender gaze,
And praise the joy their faith must bring!
Verse 5
“Son, thy sins are forgiven thee,”
Your words of mercy fill the room.
The scribes begin to question You,
But You perceive their hidden thoughts.
I praise You in Your perfect wisdom,
I bless You in Your healing power.
“Arise, take up thy bed, and go into thy house!”
You speak, and everything is changed!
Verse 6
He moves his limbs and rises up,
And stands before their wondering eyes!
The man who once was carried in
Now takes his bed and walks outside!
I love You in his every movement,
I praise You in his strength restored.
I join the wonder of the people,
And glorify Your Name, O Lord!
Chorus
Tear off the roof! Tear off the roof!
Rejoice in what our God can do!
When faithful hearts make room for grace,
The power of Jesus fills this place!
Tear off the roof! Tear off the roof!
Let every heart proclaim the truth!
He sees our faith, He hears our cry,
And raises up the soul to life!
Bridge
I rejoice in You, O Lord,
In the boldness of these men!
I praise You for their ingenuity,
And their determination to reach You.
I love You in their perseverance,
In their resolve to see it through.
I bless You in their faithful friendship,
And their confidence in You!
Outro
Every soul that longs to rise
Is carried to Your healing light.
We place them all before Your Heart,
And trust Your mercy, Lord of Life.
May Your Kingdom come,
May Your Will be done,
On earth as it is in Heaven.

songs.title: Jesus Break the Chains
songs.lyrics:
Jesus, I fuse myself in Your Most Holy Divine Will.
I come to love, praise, bless, and thank You
in every act of Your deliverance.
The Exodus
I love You in the cries of Israel,
When Pharaoh held Your people bound.
I praise You for the call of Moses,
And freedom waiting to be found.
I bless You on the night of Passover,
When You prepared to lead them home.
I thank You for the sea You parted,
And the path through which they safely roamed.
Joseph of Egypt
I love You in the trials of Joseph,
Betrayed and sold into slavery.
I praise You for Your hidden wisdom,
Turning evil into victory.
I thank You for the day You raised him,
To govern Egypt at Pharaoh’s side.
I bless You for the lives You rescued,
Through the famine reaching far and wide.
Chorus
O Jesus, break the chains that bind us,
Set humanity free!
From the tyranny of the human will,
Let Your Divine Will reign in all.
Send forth Your Spirit upon the earth,
Renew its face once more!
Where the Spirit of the Lord is,
There is liberty!
Daniel and the Three Young Men
I love You in the courage of Daniel,
Who chose Your law above the king.
I praise You when You shut the lions’ mouths,
And brought him safely through that night.
I bless You in the fiery furnace,
Where three young men refused to bow.
I thank You for Your holy presence,
That walked among the flames somehow.
Peter’s Deliverance
I love You in the prison of Peter,
Where he lay sleeping, bound in chains.
I praise You for the angel You sent,
Whose light broke through the darkened place.
I bless You as his shackles loosened,
And iron gates swung open wide.
I thank You for the path to freedom,
With Your angel walking by his side.
Chorus
O Jesus, break the chains that bind us,
Set humanity free!
From the tyranny of the human will,
Let Your Divine Will reign in all.
Send forth Your Spirit upon the earth,
Renew its face once more!
Where the Spirit of the Lord is,
There is liberty!
The Greatest Deliverance
I love You, Jesus, in Your Passion,
When You endured the scourge and Cross.
I praise You for Your Resurrection,
And the victory Your suffering brought.
I bless You for the chains You’ve broken,
For every soul Your Blood has bought.
I thank You for the gift of freedom,
And the Kingdom Your great Love has sought.
Offering Every Deliverance
I gather every act of freedom,
Through every age of history.
Each captive freed, each chain of bondage,
Each triumph of Your victory.
I join them to Your holy Passion,
And offer all to God above.
May every soul return to You,
And live within Your perfect Love.
Closing Prayer
I love You in every act of deliverance,
For every soul throughout all time.
I praise You for each captive freed,
And every chain Your Love untied.
I bless You in Your mighty victories,
I thank You for the liberty You bring.
I gather all these acts within Your Will,
And offer them to You, my King.
Come, Divine Will,
Reign throughout humanity.
May Your Kingdom come,
And may Your Will be done,
On earth as it is in Heaven.

songs.title: Flames of Fire
songs.lyrics:
Jesus, I fuse myself in Your Divine Will.
I come to love You in the virtues and suffering of Saint Joan of Arc.
I love You in her lonely prison,
Where iron chains restrained her feet.
I praise You through her sleepless nights,
Where hostile guards disturbed her peace.
I bless You when they threatened violence,
And she had nowhere safe to hide.
I honor You in her purity,
Dressing in men’s clothing to protect herself from harm.
I love You when she lay there sick,
And begged to have Communion brought.
I praise You in her longing for You,
While cruel judges answered not.
I bless You when her king was absent,
And no one came to set her free.
I honor You in her unwavering trust,
When earthly help was not to be.
Flames of fire, flames of fire,
Her greatest fear was fire.
Yet for You she surrendered.
I love You, Jesus, in her blazing love,
Brighter than the fire that burned her.
I love You, Jesus, in her pain and heroic trust,
In every trial.
Together with her, I say,
“Jesus, Jesus, Jesus,”
And die with her amid the flames.
I love You when they called her guilty,
Condemned to burn before the crowd.
I praise You when she begged for mercy,
Her cries unanswered by the proud.
I bless You when she faced the sentence,
The death by fire she feared the most.
I honor You in her surrender;
When all was lost, she held You close.
I love You as Joan stood alone,
Bound to the stake in Rouen’s square.
I praise You when she asked for Jesus
And begged to see His Cross held there.
I bless You as the flames rose higher,
As smoke and fire concealed her face.
I honor You in her final moments,
Still calling Jesus in that place.
I love You in her heart remembered,
Which flames were said to leave untouched.
They cast her ashes in the river,
Yet could not silence all her love.
I praise You in her final witness,
Her faith enduring to the end.
I bless You in her love for Jesus,
Her Savior, Lord, and faithful Friend.
I praise You as her soul takes flight.
I adore You as she joins the angels
And the saints in Heaven,
Where they celebrate her victory.
With You forever, she finds her freedom,
And is forever blessed.

songs.title: The Treasures of Your Son
songs.lyrics:
O Jesus, I immerse myself in Your Most Holy Divine Will.
Like Queen Esther before the king,
I come before the Father’s throne,
To plead for mercy upon the world,
With all Your treasures as my own.
I cover my face with the tears You cried,
Not earthly beauty or royal gold.
I clothe myself in Your Precious Blood,
A treasure greater than riches untold.
I adorn myself with Your sacred wounds,
More precious than jewels a queen could wear.
I gather all Your holy merits,
And bring the world into my prayer.
Clothed in the Blood and tears of Jesus,
Adorned with His wounds like precious gold,
I stand in the breach like Queen Esther,
Before the Father’s heavenly throne.
I plead for mercy upon all people,
With every treasure of Your Son.
O Father, look upon His merits,
And let Your Kingdom come!
I love You in the womb of Mary,
In Your stillness and confinement there.
I praise You in Your infant cries,
Your helplessness and tender care.
I bless You in Your hours of sleep,
In every breath and heartbeat small.
I honor You in Your hidden years,
And offer to the Father all.
I take Your footsteps, every word,
The loving gaze of Your holy eyes.
Your hands at work beside Saint Joseph,
Your humble labor and sacrifice.
I gather every act of obedience,
Each silent prayer and loving sigh.
I seal them all with my affection,
And lift these treasures up on high.
Clothed in the Blood and tears of Jesus,
Adorned with His wounds like precious gold,
I stand in the breach like Queen Esther,
Before the Father’s heavenly throne.
I plead for mercy upon all people,
With every treasure of Your Son.
O Father, look upon His merits,
And let Your Kingdom come!
I love You in the purity of Jesus’ eyes,
In every holy sight His eyes beheld.
I praise You in His listening ears,
And every word of love He heard.
I bless You in His gentle touch,
His sacred taste and sense of smell.
I gather every holy act He made,
To repair where mankind sins.
O Father, do not look upon
The sins and failures of mankind.
But see the merits of Your Son,
His perfect Love for all humankind.
Behold the treasures that I bring,
His every act from birth to death.
I offer You His entire life,
His every heartbeat, step, and breath.
I stand before the King of Kings,
With confidence and perfect trust.
For You are not my King alone,
But my dear Father, good and just.
I come before You as Your child,
With all the treasures of Your Son.
I know You hear my humble pleas,
And trust Your holy Will be done.
Like Esther, I plead for all Your children,
And lay these treasures at Your feet.
O Father, pour Your mercy on them,
And draw each soul into Your peace.
And from Your throne, the golden scepter
Extends in mercy toward the earth.
The King of Kings, my loving Father,
Receives the prayers of His own child.
May Your Kingdom come,
May Your Will be done,
On earth as it is in Heaven.

songs.title: The Confidence of St. Therese of Lisieux
songs.lyrics:
Jesus, I fuse myself in Your Most Holy Divine Will.
Together with Saint Thérèse of Lisieux,
I come to love You in her Little Way.
Verse 1
I love You in her little sacrifices,
In every kindness quietly done.
I praise You in her patient suffering,
In victories known to You alone.
I bless You in each irritation,
That she endured with patient love.
I honor You in her gentle smile,
Each hidden gift to God above.
Verse 2
I love You in her boundless confidence,
Her childlike trust in Your great Love.
I praise You in her sweet abandonment,
Her hope in Mercy from above.
I bless You in her littleness,
Her willingness to be so small.
I honor You in her surrender,
Trusting Your arms to lift her through it all.
Chorus
I love You in Thérèse’s confidence,
Her boundless trust in Your great Love.
I gather every hidden act of kindness,
From every soul throughout all time.
All the love that no one sees,
Each secret gift, each sacrifice,
I offer to the Father with Your Love,
Within Your Will, in endless praise.
Verse 3
I love You in the hands that serve,
And quietly clean what others leave.
I praise You in the gentle words,
That comfort hearts too hurt to speak.
I bless You in the ones who give,
And never seek a word of praise.
I honor You in those who pray,
For unknown souls throughout their days.
Verse 4
I love You in the cup of water,
Given kindly in Your name.
I praise You in the souls who forgive,
And never speak of others’ blame.
I bless You in the smallest kindness,
In every burden gently borne.
I honor You in silent patience,
In loving hearts that suffer scorn.
Bridge — Matthew 18:3
“Unless you be converted,
And become as little children…”
Jesus, I love You in the souls
Who trust Your Mercy without fear.
I praise You in their confidence,
Their humble hope, their simple faith.
I gather all their acts of love,
And offer them in Your embrace.
Final Chorus
I love You in Thérèse’s confidence,
Her boundless trust in Your great Love.
I gather every hidden act of kindness,
From every soul throughout all time.
All the love that no one sees,
Each secret gift, each sacrifice,
I offer to the Father with Your Love,
Within Your Will, in endless praise.
Ending
May Your Kingdom come,
May Your Will be done,
On earth as it is in Heaven.

songs.title: One Flame of Love
songs.lyrics:
Jesus, I fuse myself in Your Most Holy Divine Will.
I unite every part of myself to You,
To love, praise, bless, and adore the Father,
And make reparation for all souls.
I place my hands within Your hands,
And join the holy works You do.
I offer all Your perfect deeds,
For sinful hands that wounded You.
I place my feet within Your feet,
And follow every step You take.
I offer all Your holy steps,
For those who walk in sinful ways.
I place my eyes within Your eyes,
And gaze with You upon each soul.
I offer all Your loving glances,
For eyes that seek what harms the soul.
I place my ears within Your ears,
And listen with Your patient Love.
I offer all Your holy listening,
For ears that turn from truth above.
I place my voice within Your voice,
And praise the Father with Your tongue.
I offer every word You spoke,
For blasphemies and wrongs of tongue.
Part to part, all of me to all of You,
Not two, but one flame of love.
I offer all Your holy acts to the Father above,
For mercy on every soul.
I place my thoughts within Your thoughts,
And join Your Wisdom, pure and bright.
I offer every thought of Yours,
For minds that turn away from light.
I place my will within Your Will,
My every longing in Your Heart.
I offer all Your pure desires,
For souls whose passions draw apart.
I place my heart within Your Heart,
To love with Your own boundless Love.
I offer every beat of Yours,
To our Eternal Father above.
I place my tears within Your tears,
For every soul who turns away.
I offer all Your grief and sorrow,
For mercy on the world today.
Part to part, all of me to all of You,
Not two, but one flame of love.
I offer all Your holy acts to the Father above,
For mercy on every soul.
I place my work within Your work,
My daily labors joined to Yours.
I offer all Your hidden years,
And every act of Love that pours.
I place my prayers within Your prayers,
My every breath within Your breath.
I offer all Your holy acts,
From Your first breath unto Your death.
Together, Jesus, let us rise,
Before the Father’s holy throne.
I offer Him Your perfect Love,
For every sin mankind has known.
For every soul, for every age,
Let Your Divine Will reign once more.
Pour down Your mercy on the world,
And draw all souls to love You more.
Part to part, all of me to all of You,
Not two, but one flame of love.
I offer all Your holy acts to the Father above,
For mercy on every soul.
May Your Kingdom come,
May Your Will be done,
On earth as it is done in Heaven.

songs.title: Divine Will Attributes
songs.lyrics:
Jesus, I fuse myself in Your Most Holy Divine Will.
With Your own Love, I come to love, praise, bless, honor, and adore You in all Your Divine attributes.
I love You in Your boundless Love,
That pours itself upon all souls.
I praise You in Your tender Mercy,
That seeks the lost and makes them whole.
I bless You in Your endless Goodness,
Your Patience that awaits each heart.
I honor You in Your Compassion,
That never ceases to impart.
I love You in Your Divine Power,
By which all things were brought to be.
I praise You in Your Creative Strength,
That formed the heavens, earth, and sea.
I bless You in Your Divine Wisdom,
That orders all things perfectly.
I honor You in Your Providence,
That cares for all eternally.
Chorus
I love You, praise You, bless You, Lord,
In all Your attributes Divine.
I honor and adore You, God,
With all the love of Your own Heart.
I love You in Your Immutability,
Forever constant, always true.
I praise You in Your Eternity,
Where all things are present before You.
I bless You in Your Eternal Motion,
Your endless Life that knows no rest.
I honor You in Your Immensity,
Your Presence filling all that exists.
I love You in Your perfect Holiness,
Your Purity beyond compare.
I praise You in Your Divine Justice,
Forever righteous, true, and fair.
I bless You in Your Sovereignty,
Your Majesty above all things.
I honor You in Your Omnipotence,
O mighty Lord and King of kings.
Chorus
I love You, praise You, bless You, Lord,
In all Your attributes Divine.
I honor and adore You, God,
With all the love of Your own Heart.
I love You in Your Divine Light,
That shines through all eternity.
I praise You in Your Divine Truth,
That sets the captive spirit free.
I bless You in Your Infinite Life,
Your Beauty and Your Unity.
I honor You in Your Divine Will,
That reigns throughout eternity.
Final Round
Jesus, in Your Divine Will,
I place my love in all that You are.
May every soul return You love,
And may Your Kingdom reign on earth.

songs.title: In the Name of All, I Love You
songs.lyrics:
Holy God, I fuse myself in Your Most Holy Divine Will.

And here, in the name of all, I love You.

I love You with the power and love of the Heavenly Father.

I love You with the endless love of the Holy Spirit.

I love You with all the love found in the Sacred Heart of Jesus.

I love You with all the love found in the Immaculate Heart of Mary.

I love You with the love of Luisa Piccarreta.

I love You with the love of all the children of the Divine Will.

I love You with all the love of the angels.

I love You with all the love of the saints.

I love You with the love of all humanity throughout time.

And I love You on behalf of all lost souls.

I love You for all created things.

And Lord, I take hold of all the love with which You created each thing.

And gathering all this love together as my own in Your Will, I offer it to You, O Most Holy Trinity, Father, Son, and Holy Spirit, in the name of all souls.

May You be loved as You deserve.

And may Your Kingdom come and reign on earth as it reigns in Heaven.
